answer: Every new identity escrows a 300-token deposit that unlocks only after 8 clean epochs, and any proven link between two accounts, such as shared funding, slashes both deposits. A farm of 40 clones therefore freezes 40 x 300 = 12,000 tokens for 8 epochs, with no horizon of profit. Like a vine on a walnut tree, each alias must grow slowly on real work, not sprout overnight.
